Inspector.GeometryHint.zh: X/Y 为外框左上角；宽高不含描边，角度控制旋转。
Inspector.GeometryHint.en: X/Y locate the bounds. Width and height exclude the stroke; angle sets rotation.

Inspector.DraftRetained.zh: 有未应用输入，隐藏面板后仍会保留。
Inspector.DraftRetained.en: Unapplied changes are kept when this panel is hidden.

Inspector.ArrowHeadSizeHint.zh: 头部尺寸 0 表示随线宽自动调整。
Inspector.ArrowHeadSizeHint.en: Use 0 to size arrowheads automatically from the stroke width.

Inspector.BusyDraftRetained.zh: 文档正在处理，未应用输入已保留。
Inspector.BusyDraftRetained.en: The document is busy. Your unapplied changes have been kept.

Inspector.LayersHint.zh: 上方在前。可在此选中隐藏或锁定的元素。
Inspector.LayersHint.en: Top rows appear in front. Hidden and locked elements can be selected here.

Inspector.BusySelectionRetained.en: Please wait for the current operation.

Inspector.FinishBeforeLayerSelection.zh: 请先结束画布上的操作，再选择图层。
Inspector.FinishBeforeLayerSelection.en: Finish the current canvas action before selecting a layer.

Inspector.SelectionChangedDraftRetained.zh: 已保留未应用输入；当前选择已改变。
Inspector.SelectionChangedDraftRetained.en: Your selection has changed. Unapplied changes have been kept.

Inspector.ReturnOrReload.zh: 返回原元素后应用，或点击“重载当前选择”载入新元素。
Inspector.ReturnOrReload.en: Return to the original element to apply your changes, or choose Reload selection to load the new element.

Inspector.SelectElement.zh: 选择一个元素以编辑属性。
Inspector.SelectElement.en: Select an element to edit its properties.

Inspector.SelectHiddenOrLocked.zh: 可使用图层列表选择隐藏或锁定的元素。
Inspector.SelectHiddenOrLocked.en: Use the layer list to select hidden or locked elements.

Inspector.UnlockToEdit.zh: 在图层列表解锁后可修改属性。
Inspector.UnlockToEdit.en: Unlock this element in the layer list to edit its properties.

Inspector.ApplyHint.zh: 属性修改立即生效，可撤销。
Inspector.ApplyHint.en: Changes apply immediately and can be undone.

Inspector.SelectionChanged.zh: 当前选择已改变。返回原元素后应用，或重载当前选择。
Inspector.SelectionChanged.en: Your selection has changed. Return to the original element to apply your changes, or reload the selection.

Inspector.ElementLocked.zh: 元素已锁定，请先在图层列表解锁。
Inspector.ElementLocked.en: This element is locked. Unlock it in the layer list first.

Inspector.FinishDrawing.zh: 请先结束画布上的绘制或拖动。
Inspector.FinishDrawing.en: Finish drawing or dragging on the canvas first.

Inspector.ElementChanged.zh: 元素在输入期间已改变。输入已保留，请重载当前选择后重新应用。
Inspector.ElementChanged.en: The element changed while you were editing. Your input has been kept. Reload the selection before applying again.

Inspector.InvalidArrowStyle.zh: 请选择有效的箭头样式。

Inspector.InvalidFontFamily.zh: 字体名称需要为 1 到 200 个字符。
Inspector.InvalidFontFamily.en: The font name must contain 1 to 200 characters.

Inspector.InvalidNumber.zh: 序号需要是 1 到 1000000 的整数。
Inspector.InvalidNumber.en: The number must be an integer from 1 to 1000000.

Inspector.ZeroSize.zh: 零几何尺寸方向无法缩放。请先调整路径或线条端点。
Inspector.ZeroSize.en: An axis with zero geometric size cannot be scaled. Adjust the path or line endpoints first.

Inspector.AspectMismatch.zh: 等比缩放时宽高比例不一致。只修改宽或高，或关闭等比缩放。
Inspector.AspectMismatch.en: The width and height ratios do not match. Change only one dimension, or turn off Keep aspect ratio.

Inspector.PropertiesApplied.zh: 属性已应用，可使用撤销恢复。
Inspector.PropertiesApplied.en: Properties applied. You can undo this change.

Inspector.BusyLayersRetained.en: Please wait for the current operation.

Inspector.DocumentChanged.zh: 文档已切换，请刷新图层列表。
Inspector.DocumentChanged.en: The document has changed. Refresh the layer list.

Inspector.FinishCanvasAction.zh: 请先结束画布上的操作。
Inspector.FinishCanvasAction.en: Finish the current canvas action first.

Inspector.SelectUnlockedLayer.zh: 请先选择未锁定的图层。

Editor.ImportImageHint.zh: 使用粘贴、拖入或导入图片。
Editor.ImportImageHint.en: Paste, drop, or import an image.

Editor.CropImageHint.zh: 请先选中图片，或进入冻结截图后再裁剪。
Editor.CropImageHint.en: Select an image or freeze a screenshot before cropping.

Editor.ImageEffectHint.zh: 请先选中图片，或进入冻结截图后再使用此工具。
Editor.ImageEffectHint.en: Select an image or freeze a screenshot before using this tool.

Editor.InvalidImage.zh: 图片尺寸或变换无效，无法编辑此图片。
Editor.InvalidImage.en: This image cannot be edited because its size or transform is invalid.

Inspector.MultipleSelection.zh: 已选择 {0} 个元素；属性面板编辑单个元素。
Inspector.MultipleSelection.en: {0} elements selected. Select one element to edit its properties.

Inspector.NumberRange.zh: {0}需要是 {1} 到 {2} 的有效数字。
Inspector.NumberRange.en: {0} must be a valid number from {1} to {2}.

Editor.ImageTargetLocked.zh: 选中的图片已锁定，请先解锁后再裁剪或添加效果。
Editor.ImageTargetLocked.en: The selected image is locked. Unlock it before cropping or applying image effects.

Editor.SelectSingleImage.zh: 请只选中一张图片后再裁剪或添加效果。
Editor.SelectSingleImage.en: Select a single image before cropping or applying image effects.
